name: Zero-DCE (DCE-Net) low-light image enhancement (upstream provenance copy)

input.channels: RGB normalized to [0, 1] plus a brightness-guidance channel
input.note: meant to be resized at runtime via TfLiteInterpreterResizeInputTensor

notes: Byte-identical to upstream; only works with runtimes that support ResizeInputTensor (e.g. the LiteRT Python runtime). The Rust core uses zero-dce-int8.tflite (fixed static shape) instead.
